title: Elijah at Horeb
description: Elijah flees from Jezebel and wishes for death, but an angel strengthens him for the journey to Mount Horeb. There God meets him in a gentle, quiet whisper and gives him a new mission.

versions.reason: [major] references: The existing story 'eliah-flees-from-jezebel' covers verses 1–8 of the same chapter. This proposal extends it to verses 1–18 and includes the meeting at Horeb, which is a natural continuation of the same narrative.
